devdoc.author: Tim Clancy This launchpad contract sells new items by minting them into existence. It cannot be used to sell items that already exist.

devdoc.title: A Shop contract for selling NFTs via direct minting through particular pools with specific participation requirements.

GlobalPurchaseLimitLocked(address).notice: An event to track future changes to `globalPurchaseLimit` being locked.

GlobalPurchaseLimitUpdated(address,uint2.notice: An event to track an update to this shop's `globalPurchaseLimit`.

ItemPurchased(address,uint256,uint256[],.notice: An event to track the purchase of items from an item pool.

ManagementUpdated(address,bytes32,bytes3.notice: An event emitted when a management relationship in `managerRight` is updated. This event captures adding and revoking management permissions via observing the update history of the `managerRight` value.

PaymentReceiverLocked(address).notice: An event to track future changes to `paymentReceiver` being locked.

PaymentReceiverUpdated(address,address,a.notice: An event to track an update to this shop's `paymentReceiver`.

PermitUpdated(address,address,bytes32,by.notice: An event emitted when an address has a permit updated. This event captures, through its various parameter combinations, the cases of granting a permit, updating the expiration time of a permit, or revoking a permit.

PoolUpdated(address,uint256,(string,uint.notice: An event to track an item pool's data being updated. When emitted this event indicates that a specific item pool's settings have been completely replaced.

SweepLocked(address).notice: An event to track future use of the `sweep` function being locked.

TokenSweep(address,address,uint256,addre.notice: An event to track a token sweep event.

WhitelistActiveUpdate(address,uint256,bo.notice: An event to track activating or deactivating a whitelist.

WhitelistAddition(address,uint256,addres.notice: An event to track the addition of addresses to a specific whitelist. When emitted this event indicates that a specific whitelist has had `addresses` added to it.

WhitelistRemoval(address,uint256,address.notice: An event to track the removal of addresses to a specific whitelist. When emitted this event indicates that a specific whitelist has had `addresses` removed from it.

WhitelistUpdated(address,uint256,address.notice: An event to track a specific whitelist being updated. When emitted this event indicates that a specific whitelist has had its settings completely replaced.

LOCK_GLOBAL_LIMIT().notice: The public identifier for the right to lock the global purchase limit.

LOCK_PAYMENT_RECEIVER().notice: The public identifier for the right to lock the payment receiver.

LOCK_SWEEP().notice: The public identifier for the right to lock token sweeps.

POOL().notice: The public identifier for the right to manage item pools.

SET_PAYMENT_RECEIVER().notice: The public identifier for the right to set the payment receiver.

SWEEP().notice: The public identifier for the right to sweep tokens.

UNIVERSAL().notice: A special constant specifying the unique, universal-rights circumstance.

UPDATE_GLOBAL_LIMIT().notice: The public identifier for the right to update the global purchase limit.

WHITELIST().notice: The public identifier for the right to manage whitelists.

ZERO_RIGHT().notice: A special reserved constant for representing no rights.

addPool((string,uint256,uint256,uint256,.notice: Allow the owner of the shop or an approved manager to add a new pool of items that users may purchase.

addToWhitelist(uint256,address[]).notice: Allow the owner or an approved manager to add specified addresses to an existing whitelist.

addWhitelist((uint256,bool,address[])).notice: Allow the owner or an approved manager to add a new whitelist.

constructor.notice: Construct a new shop which can mint items upon purchase from various pools.

getPools(uint256[]).notice: A function which allows the caller to retrieve information about specific pools, the items for sale within, and the collection this shop uses.

getPoolsWithAddress(uint256[],address).notice: A function which allows the caller to retrieve information about specific pools, the items for sale within, and the collection this launchpad uses. A provided address differentiates this function from `getPools`; the added address enables this function to retrieve pool data as well as whitelisting and purchase count details for the provided address.

getPurchaseCounts(uint256[],address[]).notice: A function which allows the caller to retrieve the number of items specific addresses have purchased from specific pools.

getWhitelistStatus(uint256[],address[]).notice: A function which allows the caller to retrieve whether or not addresses can participate in some given whitelists.

globalPurchaseCounts(address).notice: A mapping of addresses to the number of items each has purchased globally.

globalPurchaseLimit().notice: A limit on the number of items that a particular address may purchase across any number of pools in this shop.

globalPurchaseLimitLocked().notice: A flag determining whether or not the `globalPurchaseLimit` may be updated using the `updateGlobalPurchaseLimit` function.

hasRightUntil(address,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Determine whether or not an address has some rights under the given circumstance, and if they do have the right, until when.

item().notice: The item collection contract that minted items are sold from.

lockGlobalPurchaseLimit().notice: Allow the shop owner or an approved manager to lock the global purchase limit against any future changes.

lockPaymentReceiver().notice: Allow the shop owner or an approved manager to lock the payment receiver address against any future changes.

lockSweep().notice: Allow the shop owner or an approved manager to lock the contract against any future token sweeps.

managerRight(bytes32).notice: An additional mapping of managed rights to manager rights. This mapping represents the administrator relationship that various rights have with one another. An address with a manager right may freely set permits for that manager right's managed rights. Each right may be managed by only one other right.

mintFromPool(uint256,uint256,uint256,uin.notice: Allow a buyer to purchase an item from a pool.

nextItemIssues(uint256).notice: This mapping relates each item group ID to the next item ID within that group which should be issued, minus one.

nextPoolId().notice: The next available ID to be assumed by the next pool added.

nextWhitelistId().notice: The ID which should be taken by the next whitelist added. This value begins at one in order to reserve the zero-identifier for representing no whitelist at all, i.e. public.

paymentReceiver().notice: The address where the payment from each item buyer is sent. Care must be taken that this address can actually take receipt of the Ether or ERC-20 earnings.

paymentReceiverLocked().notice: A flag determining whether or not the `paymentReceiver` may be updated using the `updatePaymentReceiver` function.

permissions(address,bytes32,bytes32).notice: A mapping of per-address permissions to the circumstances, represented as an additional layer of generic bytes32 data, under which the addresses have various permits. A permit in this sense is represented by a per-circumstance mapping which couples some right, represented as a generic bytes32, to an expiration time wherein the right may no longer be exercised. An expiration time of 0 indicates that there is in fact no permit for the specified address to exercise the specified right under the specified circumstance.

pools(uint256).notice: A mapping of pool IDs to pools.

removeFromWhitelist(uint256,address[]).notice: Allow the owner or an approved manager to remove specified addresses from an existing whitelist.

setManagerRight(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Set the `_managerRight` whose `UNIVERSAL` holders may freely manage the specified `_managedRight`.

setPermit(address,bytes32,bytes32,uint25.notice: Set the permit to a specific address under some circumstances. A permit may only be set by the super-administrative contract owner or an address holding some delegated management permit.

setWhitelistActive(uint256,bool).notice: Allow the owner or an approved manager to manually set the active status of a specific whitelist.

sweep(address,uint256,address).notice: Allow the owner or an approved manager to sweep all of a particular ERC-20 token from the contract and send it to another address. This function exists to allow the shop owner to recover tokens that are otherwise sent directly to this contract and get stuck. Provided that sweeping is not locked, this is a useful tool to help buyers recover otherwise-lost funds.

sweepLocked().notice: A flag determining whether or not the `sweep` function may be used.

updateGlobalPurchaseLimit(uint256).notice: Allow the shop owner or an approved manager to update the global purchase limit if it has not been locked.

updatePaymentReceiver(address).notice: Allow the shop owner or an approved manager to update the payment receiver address if it has not been locked.

updatePool(uint256,(string,uint256,uint2.notice: Allow the owner of the shop or an approved manager to update an existing pool of items.

updateWhitelist(uint256,(uint256,bool,ad.notice: Allow the owner or an approved manager to update a whitelist. This completely replaces the existing content for that whitelist.

version().notice: Return a version number for this contract's interface.

whitelists(uint256).notice: A mapping of whitelist IDs to specific Whitelist elements. Whitelists may be shared between pools via specifying their ID in a pool requirement.
